population.label: US population
population.source_name: U.S. Census Bureau, Vintage 2025 population estimates (NST-EST2025)
population.method: Official resident population on July 1, 2025 (Vintage 2025): 341,784,857. Projected forward at Census population clock's stated rate (0.030359/s ≈ 958,051/yr). For reference, V2025's own Jul 2024→Jul 2025 change was 1,781,060 (net international migration 1,262,202); Census's current clock assumes slower growth, mainly lower net migration. The live clock level is used only as a cross-check.

households.label: US households
households.method: Annual survey figure (134.79M). Updated each December.

tax_returns.label: Individual income tax returns filed
tax_returns.method: 162,754,810 individual income tax returns filed in FY2025 (IRS Data Book, Table 1-2). Used as the 'per tax return filed' denominator. It counts returns, not people: a joint return counts once, and returns with zero tax liability are included.

debt_total.label: US national debt
debt_total.method: Starts at Treasury's official figure for 2026-10-27 (close of business). Rate: 90-day least-squares trend (63 daily records), the same window for total, public and intragovernmental debt so the parts add up to the total. Re-based every business day. Backtested against the next Treasury close over the last 20 business days: average error 0.069%.

debt_public.label: Debt held by the public
debt_public.method: Starts at Treasury's official figure for 2026-10-27 (close of business). Rate: 90-day least-squares trend (63 daily records), the same window for total, public and intragovernmental debt so the parts add up to the total. Re-based every business day.

debt_intragov.label: Intragovernmental debt
debt_intragov.method: Starts at Treasury's official figure for 2026-10-27 (close of business). Rate: 90-day least-squares trend (63 daily records), the same window for total, public and intragovernmental debt so the parts add up to the total. Re-based every business day.

gdp.label: GDP (annual rate)
gdp.method: Nominal GDP, seasonally adjusted annual rate, 2026-Q2 = $32.563T. Ticks at the trend of the last 4 quarters, anchored at mid-quarter.

revenue.label: Federal revenue
revenue.source_name: Treasury Daily Treasury Statement, calibrated to the Monthly Treasury Statement
revenue.method: FY2027 to date, budget basis, re-based every business day: DTS FYTD cash through 2026-10-27 ($402.8B) × 0.8238 budget-to-cash ratio from FY2026. Ticks toward the projected close for 2026-10-28: expected cash $19.1B × 0.8238 (non-customs receipts from the same weekdays a year earlier, scaled by the trailing-year growth, plus customs duties from the same business day last month, since tariffs arrive in one monthly lump). Between Treasury statements the figure is our projection; the official number replaces it every business day. FY2026 final (MTS): $5,403.3B. Resets to $0 every Oct 1.

validation.against: Treasury Daily Treasury Statement, calibrated to the Monthly Treasury Statement

spending.label: Federal spending
spending.source_name: Treasury Daily Treasury Statement, calibrated to the Monthly Treasury Statement
spending.method: FY2027 to date, budget basis, re-based every business day: DTS FYTD cash through 2026-10-27 ($557.0B) × 0.8972 budget-to-cash ratio from FY2026. Ticks toward the projected close for 2026-10-28: expected cash $19.6B × 0.8972 (outlays on the same weekdays a year earlier, scaled by the trailing-year growth). Between Treasury statements the figure is our projection; the official number replaces it every business day. FY2026 final (MTS): $7,395.8B. Resets to $0 every Oct 1.

validation.against: Treasury Daily Treasury Statement, calibrated to the Monthly Treasury Statement

deficit.label: Federal deficit
deficit.source_name: Treasury Daily Treasury Statement, calibrated to the Monthly Treasury Statement
deficit.method: Spending minus revenue, both re-based daily and ticking.

validation.against: Treasury Daily Treasury Statement, calibrated to the Monthly Treasury Statement

interest_cash.label: Interest paid to bondholders (cash)
interest_cash.source_name: Treasury Daily Treasury Statement (Interest on Treasury Securities)
interest_cash.method: Cash interest paid on Treasury securities FY2027 to date, official through 2026-10-27 and re-based every business day. Treasury pays coupons in lumps on the 15th and at month-end (next business day if that is a holiday or weekend), so the projection follows that calendar: each upcoming payment is estimated from the payment for the same coupon date six months earlier (notes and bonds pay every six months), adjusted for half of its six-month growth; other business days add the median ordinary day ($5.0M). Next projected payment: $31.5B on 2026-11-02. Projected amounts are estimates until Treasury's statement for that day is published.

validation.against: Treasury Daily Treasury Statement (Interest on Treasury Securities)

interest_gross.label: Gross interest expense on Treasury debt
interest_gross.source_name: Treasury, Interest Expense on the Public Debt Outstanding
interest_gross.method: One measure throughout: Treasury's monthly interest expense on all Treasury securities (accrual basis, including interest credited to trust funds and amortized discounts). FY2027 to date starts at $0 on Oct 1 and ticks at the last 12 reported months' total ($1,360.4B/yr, 2025-10 to 2026-09), which is also the official FY2026 total ($1,360.4B). Larger than 'Net interest' (budget function 900) because interest paid to trust funds nets out there, and different from cash interest paid on the DTS.

rate_marketable.label: Avg interest rate, total marketable
rate_marketable.source_name: Treasury, Average Interest Rates on U.S. Treasury Securities
rate_marketable.method: Monthly official average; changes once a month.

rate_all.label: Avg interest rate, total interest-bearing debt
rate_all.source_name: Treasury, Average Interest Rates on U.S. Treasury Securities
rate_all.method: Monthly official average; changes once a month.

debt_subject_limit.label: Debt subject to the limit
debt_subject_limit.source_name: Treasury Daily Treasury Statement, Table III-C
debt_subject_limit.method: Total debt minus debt not subject to limit (unamortized discount, FFB, other). Official close 2026-10-27; ticks at the 90-day trend (63 records).

validation.against: Treasury Daily Treasury Statement, Table III-C

debt_limit.label: Statutory debt limit
debt_limit.source_name: Treasury Daily Treasury Statement, Table III-C
debt_limit.method: Set by Congress. Changes only when the law changes.

fed_treasuries.label: Fed holdings of Treasuries
fed_treasuries.source_name: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, SOMA holdings (H.4.1 basis)
fed_treasuries.method: Bills + notes/bonds + FRNs + TIPS incl. inflation compensation, par value, weekly (Wednesday). Ticks at the 13-week trend.

m2.label: M2 money supply
m2.source_name: Federal Reserve H.6 Money Stock (M2, seasonally adjusted)
m2.method: Monthly average for 2026-09 = $23.414T; ticks at the 6-month trend, anchored mid-month.

tf_socsec.label: Social Security trust funds (OASI + DI)

tf_socsec.method: Par value of Treasury securities held by the fund(s) at month-end 2026-09-30. Ticks at the 12-month trend; a falling number means the fund is being drawn down.

debt_gdp_now.label: Debt-to-GDP, now
debt_gdp_now.method: Live national debt ÷ live GDP (annual rate). Both tick.

deficit_gdp_now.label: Deficit-to-GDP, trailing 12 months
deficit_gdp_now.method: Last 12 months of official MTS outlays minus receipts ÷ live GDP.

interest_share.label: Net interest as share of revenue
interest_share.method: FY-to-date net interest ÷ FY-to-date revenue (both ticking).

interest_annual.label: Annual interest on today's debt
interest_annual.method: Live national debt × Treasury's average interest rate on all interest-bearing debt. What a year of interest costs at today's debt and rates.

interest_per_sec.label: Interest cost per second
interest_per_sec.method: Annual interest on today's debt ÷ seconds in a year.

limit_headroom.label: Room left under the debt limit
limit_headroom.method: Statutory debt limit minus live debt subject to limit. Goes negative only on paper; Treasury would use extraordinary measures first.

interest_since_open.label: Interest accrued since you opened this page
interest_since_open.method: Annual interest on today's debt × seconds since page load ÷ seconds per year.

fed_share_public.label: Share of public debt held by the Fed
fed_share_public.method: Fed Treasury holdings (NY Fed SOMA) ÷ live debt held by the public.

m2_debt_ratio.label: National debt as % of M2
m2_debt_ratio.method: Live national debt ÷ live M2 money supply.

debt_per_household.label: Debt per household
debt_per_household.method: Live national debt ÷ 134.79M households (Census CPS ASEC 2025).
